svg.data-weight-note: AS4625-54T: 5.8 kg, includes two PSUs (the guide gives both models in one line)
svg.data-input-ac: 100-120 VAC 4 A max; 200-240 VAC 2 A max
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: Six 1G/10G SFP+ uplinks, ports 49-54, which both documents call uplinks. The guide's lamp legend gives them two rates - "SFP+ Port LEDs: Green (10G), Amber (1G)" - and no breakout table is published, so none is stated here.

g.data-description: the forty-eight 1G RJ-45 ports, two rows of twenty-four columns ganged in three blocks of eight, numbered 1-48 down each column. NO PoE on this model - that is the whole difference from edgecore/eps122, and it is worth 150 W against 2400.

g.data-description: the six 1G/10G SFP+ uplinks, three stacked pairs at the right of the port wall, numbered 49-54 into the same sequence as the RJ-45 ports. `index-origin` is 1 because the schema allows 0 or 1 and nothing else; the 49 the panel prints is carried by each port's own `rel-pos`, which is where the panel's numbering belongs.
